description: Keep one section of a video. Takes video files. Needs FFmpeg.

exact.description:
Re-encode for a cut on the exact frame (MP4). `false` copies the streams: fast, but cut at
the nearest key frame, in the input's own format.

keep_audio.description: Keep the sound (`false` leaves it out).

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

to.description: End, in seconds; the end of the video when left out.

name: video_trim
title: Trim
